[EN] The fierce resistance of the Atel Akaad is frightening. It's as if something were controlling them.

Go kill the {@LinkCreature:25#1021#devan prelates} and {@LinkCreature:25#1022#skeletal wardens}. We'll see if anything changes. Maybe they're controlling the beasts.
[ES] La feroz resistencia de los Atel Akaad es aterradora. Es como si algo los estuviera controlando.

Ve a matar a los {@LinkCreature:25#1021#devan prelates} y {@LinkCreature:25#1022#skeletal wardens}. Veremos si algo cambia. Tal vez estén controlando a las bestias.

[EN] A psycho-suppressive shackle! So this is how they were controlling the Atel Akaad!
[ES] ¡Un grillete psicosupresor! ¡Así es como estaban controlando a los Atel Akaad!

[EN] There must be something that keeps those dread knights leashed.
[ES] Debe haber algo que mantenga atados a esos dread knights.
